name: GD.D8.actual_remainder_limits
type:
∀ (N b m E Er : ℕ → ℝ) (c a : ℝ),
  (∀ (k : ℕ), 0 < N k) →
    0 < c →
      a < 1 →
        (∀ (k : ℕ), 0 ≤ b k) →
          (∀ (k : ℕ), b k < N k) →
            (∀ (k : ℕ), b k ≤ E k / c) →
              (∀ (k : ℕ), 0 ≤ Er k) →
                (∀ (k : ℕ), Er k ≤ E k) →
                  Filter.Tendsto (fun k => E k / N k) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
                    Filter.Tendsto (fun k => m k / (N k - b k)) Filter.atTop (nhds a) →
                      Filter.Tendsto (fun k => b k / N k) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
                        Filter.Tendsto (fun k => (N k - b k) / N k) Filter.atTop (nhds 1) ∧
                          Filter.Tendsto (fun k => m k / N k) Filter.atTop (nhds a) ∧
                            Filter.Tendsto (fun k => (N k - b k - m k) / N k) Filter.atTop (nhds (1 - a)) ∧
                              Filter.Tendsto (fun k => Er k / (N k - b k - m k)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

            (GD.pairedPoly a b c d z < 0 ↔ z < GD.K (GD.K a b) (GD.K c d)) ∧
              (GD.pairedPoly a b c d z = 0 ↔ z = GD.K (GD.K a b) (GD.K c d)) ∧
                (0 < GD.pairedPoly a b c d z ↔ GD.K (GD.K a b) (GD.K c d) < z)

name: GD.lemma_3_3_first
type:
∀ {a b c d : ℝ},
  0 ≤ a →
    0 ≤ b →
      0 ≤ c →
        0 ≤ d →
          ∀ (z : ℝ),
            GD.pairedPoly a c b d z - GD.pairedPoly a b c d z =
              2 * z ^ 2 * (d - a) * (c - b) * GD.quartic a b c d (a * d + b * c) z

name: GD.lemma_3_3_second
type:
∀ {a b c d : ℝ},
  0 ≤ a →
    0 ≤ b →
      0 ≤ c →
        0 ≤ d →
          ∀ (z : ℝ),
            GD.pairedPoly a d b c z - GD.pairedPoly a c b d z =
              2 * z ^ 2 * (b - a) * (d - c) * GD.quartic a b c d (a * b + c * d) z

name: GD.lemma_3_4
type:

  0 ≤ a →
    0 ≤ b →
      0 ≤ c →
        0 ≤ d →
          0 < GD.K a b →
            0 < GD.K c d →
              ∀ (E : ℝ),
                GD.quartic a b c d E (GD.K (GD.K a b) (GD.K c d)) =
                  2 * (a * b * GD.K c d ^ 2 + c * d * GD.K a b ^ 2 - E * GD.K a b * GD.K c d) *
                      (GD.K a b * GD.K c d + GD.K a b * GD.K (GD.K a b) (GD.K c d) +
                        GD.K c d * GD.K (GD.K a b) (GD.K c d)) /

          Filter.Tendsto (fun k => GD.deficit (s k) / ↑(s k)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
            Filter.Tendsto (fun k => ↑(m k) / ↑(s k)) Filter.atTop (nhds β) →
              β = GD.alpha ∧
                Filter.Tendsto (fun k => GD.U (m k) ^ GD.q / ↑(m k)) Filter.atTop (nhds 1) ∧
